name: Areki Sae
source:
A seemingly lazy adult who always complains about things being a bother.
However, he seems to suddenly turn into a different person when it comes to work, and many admire him in secret.
He came to teach at Hosekigaoka Academy for a certain purpose. He appears to be an old acquaintance of Amahashi Yukiya.
